name: 08690 · Hamilton, NJ
findings: ZIP 08690 (Hamilton) has 97 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08690 (Hamilton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 10 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.
